ops.title: Verify fresh native consumers select native before first ship
ops.description: The cc-skills owner reported its first official v0.87.50 ship selected the Graphite API despite ccx.stack=github and Trunk queue configuration. It committed 2521... and timed out reading Graphite pull-request-info; the caller remained clean and had no remote branch or PR. The root chose supported gh stack init --base dev followed by no-commit resume. Pre-firstship metadata ownership is not yet established: preserve actual legacy-owned branches on Graphite, while genuinely unowned branches must honor native/configGithub selection. Collect the caller CWD and before/after ownership evidence before attributing the route or changing precedence.

ops.text: Pre-firstship branch ownership and resolved provider are supported by receipts.
A genuinely unowned branch with ccx.stack=github uses native metadata/API.
An actual legacy-owned branch remains Graphite until explicit conversion.
